project: Auto Evolution Structured Output Contract Conformance
description: Run the independent Structured Final Output Contract V1 conformance matrix without changing reasoning workload, retry scope, or full P3 authority.

userStories.title: Establish conformance preflight and evidence shape
userStories.description: As the product owner, I want a minimal attributable conformance experiment boundary so that runtime communication evidence can be collected without redesigning production communication infrastructure. See PRD §5.
acceptanceCriteria: Current Structured Final Output Contract V1 renderer/validator behavior is identified from repository source
Exact trivial participant-contract-conformance-v1 payload and the five allowed trial classifications are fixed
No repository reasoning workload is part of the experiment
No Host semantic repair, retry-policy change, Role-schema change, provider-routing change, or production-timeout change is introduced
Evidence output path/shape is attributable and remains experiment evidence rather than workflow authority
Any experiment helper added is minimal and focused
Focused preflight test or dry-run passes if a helper is added
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: See PRD §5 and global constraints §3/§9. Experiment helper added under scripts/evolution/contractConformance/; production Contract V1 / retry / Role schemas / timeouts unchanged. Preflight test + dry-run READY.

userStories.title: Run three Codex current-binding conformance trials
userStories.description: As the product owner, I want three fresh Codex contract-only trials so that terminal-envelope reliability is observed independently of reasoning quality. See PRD §6.
acceptanceCriteria: Exactly three valid attributable Codex current-binding trials are recorded
Every trial is classified as PASS, ENVELOPE_FAILURE, ROLE_SCHEMA_FAILURE, RUNTIME_FAILURE, or TIMEOUT
Each trial records terminal payload reference and elapsed/runtime evidence when observable
Participant output is not semantically repaired or JSON-extracted from prose
A failed valid trial is retained as evidence rather than rerun merely to obtain PASS
No real repository reasoning workload is introduced
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: See PRD §6. Evidence-only / NO_SOURCE_CHANGE is a valid Story outcome.

userStories.title: Run three Cursor Auto conformance trials
userStories.description: As the product owner, I want three fresh Cursor Auto contract-only trials so that provider-native transport behavior and terminal Contract V1 conformance are observed without inventing model identity claims. See PRD §7.
acceptanceCriteria: Exactly three valid attributable Cursor Auto trials are recorded
Every trial uses one of the five accepted classifications
Provider-native terminal-field extraction, if used, is deterministic transport extraction only
No JSON-looking block is extracted from Participant prose as repair
No unverified resolved model name is claimed
No provider fallback, retry expansion, or production-timeout change is introduced
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: See PRD §7. Do not add fixed-model bindings unless binding can be reliably requested and observed.

userStories.title: Produce the Contract Conformance Matrix verdict
userStories.description: As the product owner, I want one evidence-level matrix verdict so that Contract V1 runtime status can be updated without conflating communication reliability with reasoning quality. See PRD §8.
acceptanceCriteria: Matrix includes all six required valid trials
Per-trial classification is traceable to evidence
Codex current binding and Cursor Auto observations remain separate
Contract reliability is explicitly separated from real Solution reasoning quality
Verdict is exactly CONTRACT_CONFORMANCE_PROMISING, CONTRACT_CONFORMANCE_UNSTABLE, CONTRACT_CONFORMANCE_REGRESSION, or OBSERVATION_INSUFFICIENT
Fixed-model binding uncertainty is recorded without fabricated A/B evidence
Current-stage/governance is updated only if an explicit evidence status actually changes
Full P3 remains DEFERRED and Slice #2 boundaries remain unchanged
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: See PRD §8. Stop after matrix closure and return to Human delta review.
